name: KNMI: warnings

frame.part: top of the page, no scrolling

capture_note: The frame is read in the browser from the display vault with the published read key and checked against the sha256; no image is kept in git. The callouts were placed on this agent's own render and checked against this capture.
licence_for_showing_the_screenshot: KNMI states the Creative Commons zero declaration (CC0) for its website content unless marked (its copyright page): the screenshot may be shown.
summary: Seen on a quiet night: what a warnings page says when there is nothing to warn about, and where it puts "what can I do".

callouts.title: The state in one plain line
callouts.does_well: "Er zijn geen waarschuwingen" (there are no warnings), as a line of text above the map, and again as a heading.
callouts.fed_by: warnings.json (when nothing is in force, say so in words)

callouts.title: A quiet map
callouts.does_well: The country with no colour at all when nothing is in force.

callouts.title: What it warns for
callouts.does_well: One sentence listing the hazards KNMI warns about.
callouts.fed_by: a line in our legend: the eight hazards IPMA warns for

callouts.title: What can I expect and what can I do
callouts.does_well: One link per hazard: thunderstorms, heavy gusts and storm, snow, ice, heavy rain, cold, heat.
callouts.fed_by: ANEPC's measures per hazard, quoted and linked

limits: No warning was in force in the Netherlands, so the page in use was not seen.
